title: Sources: Anthropic is guiding prospective IPO investors that it expects to price its shares at or above the high end of its $70 to $78 marketed range (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic is guiding prospective IPO investors that it expects to price its shares at or above the high end of its $70 to $78 marketed range — Anthropic PBC is guiding prospective investors in its initial public offering it expects to price the shares at the high end of the price range or above …
